name: Computer Use
description: Lets agents operate this computer's apps, and shows what they do. Each task's Computer tab shows the window its agent works in, its cursor and its steps.
author: Gugu

zh-CN.description: 让 Agent 操作这台电脑上的应用，并看到它在做什么：每个任务的「电脑」页签显示它正在操作的窗口、它的光标和每一步。

examples: 查看当前打开的原生应用
帮我在这个应用里完成操作
